data.name: Gita
data.gender_notes: Gita is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root gai, 'to sing' — gītā, 'song'. Its root is Sanskrit gai (गै). The Bhagavad Gita, the 'Song of the Lord'. Gita is a Sanskrit name meaning “Song; the Bhagavad Gita”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gita expresses “Song; the Bhagavad Gita”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root gai, 'to sing' — gītā, 'song'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gita total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
